newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares ease back, seen fluctuating.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares ease back, seen fluctuating.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 1.79 percent on Tuesday on what traders attributed to profit-taking after recent gains and forecast a volatile market over the short term.
* The SBI index fell 26.3 points to 1,441.1.
* Overall 13 shares fell, two rose and one was unchanged, while another nine were untraded.
* Bank SKB was the most active share, falling 6.07 percent to 58,000 tolars on volume of 2,765 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
